note: docs/528: repro of the datingprofile fix (online dating records made for Sims who never made a profile, issue #175), off then on in one load. Needs a core without the b98 IL patch (simler90's UPDATE242 core without our patches in Mods/Packages): the player's core carries the same fix, so with it the off arm sees no bug. Job 1 with AutShadow on, job 2 with the release defaults; both have AutShadow's managed H4 hook (installed at every start), which carries the DidSimsMeetOnline part.
